"Deputy Jordan Cannon was a courageous and compassionate deputy who was senselessly murdered at her residence in Oklahoma City early this morning," (Cleveland County Sheriff Chris) Amason said. "This heinous act not only robs us of a dedicated and courageous public servant but also shakes the foundation of the community in which she served." "Jordan was a ray of sunshine. She had a smile that could light up a room," the sheriff said. "She loved law enforcement and had a heart for serving the community. Her loss will be felt for a very, very long time."
